turns.content: An initially neutral spherical conductor contains an offset cavity with charge +q. What total charge is induced on the inner cavity wall?

Why does the result depend on L rather than the cavity-centre distance l or offset s?
Which cavity variables disappear, and why is the spherical outer boundary essential?
Report the field magnitude at P and the uniqueness argument.
